paper_title: Lung function and microbiota diversity in cystic fibrosis
skip_reason: No healthy control group. Study compares CF patients stratified by lung disease severity (severe <40% FEV1, moderate 40-69% FEV1, mild/normal >=70% FEV1). All 299 subjects have cystic fibrosis; there is no disease-vs-healthy-control comparison. Qualification gate requires a disease group compared against healthy controls.
